ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity white/grey clusters accounting for less than 5% concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid black pigmentation across the central, proximal, and mid-lobe regions. High-contrast white/grey circular and irregular blobs are mapped exclusively to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch centrally located between lobes; approximately 40-50 degree internal angle with a significant vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes are visible along the entire trailing edge boundary from the median notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, with the sweep trajectory trending upward and outward toward pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white/grey circular pixel formations (rosettes) are localized on the extreme outer edges and tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness of the trailing edge and significant localized calcified clusters at the distal tips.
